title: Smooth approximation of a map that is Lipschitz near a set: McShane extension, mollification with local derivative bounds, and tangential vanishing of pulled-back forms (supplied Part 1, 5.5, 6.8)
statement: Let m, m′ ∈ ℕ, G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} (ℝ^p = Eucl p), Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, A ⊆ ℝ^m and δ > 0, and assume G is Λ-Lipschitz on the open δ-neighbourhood thickening δ A. Then there are Ĝ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, maps G_j : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} (j ∈ ℕ) and L ∈ ℝ≥0 such that: (a) Ĝ is L-Lipschitz on ℝ^m and Ĝ = G on thickening δ A; (b) every G_j is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)) and L-Lipschitz on ℝ^m; (c) G_j → Ĝ uniformly on ℝ^m; (d) ‖fderiv ℝ G_j x‖ ≤ Λ for all j and all x ∈ thickening (δ/2) A; (e) (tangential vanishing) for all k ∈ ℕ, α ∈ SimonMultiIndex k m′, z ∈ ℝ^{m′}, ω ∈ TestFormOn univ k (on ℝ^{m′}) and ε > 0 such that every x ∈ thickening ε A with G(x) ∈ thickening ε (tsupport ω) satisfies G(x)_i = z_i for every i ∉ range α, and ω(y)(e_{α(1)}, …, e_{α(k)}) = 0 for every y ∈ ℝ^{m′} (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1), there is r > 0 such that for all sufficiently large j and all x ∈ thickening r A the covector ω(G_j(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G_j x) is zero.
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (A : Set (Eucl m)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening δ A) → ∃ (G' : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L G' ∧ EqOn G' G (thickening δ A) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj j)) ∧ (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (Gj j)) ∧ TendstoUniformly Gj G' atTop ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ thickening (δ / 2) A, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj j) x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (α : SimonMultiIndex k m') (z : Eucl m') (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → (∀ x ∈ thickening ε A, G x ∈ thickening ε (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k)) → ∀ i, i ∉ range α → G x i = z i) → (∀ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) y (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (α j) (1 : ℝ)) = 0) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x ∈ thickening r A, ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj j) x) = 0
